instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: AccessAura Support Link coordinates non-clinical accessibility support for scheduled appointments. Clients request appointments and describe needed support, Scheduling Agents link and route requests, Accessibility Coordinators assign Service Assistants or record unavailability, Service Assistants record preparation, and Scheduling Agents send readiness outcomes before appointments. Support categories, assistant-assignment rules, and delivery channels remain unresolved; clinical treatment and transport booking are excluded.

output.summary: AccessAura Support Link coordinates non-clinical accessibility support for scheduled appointments and communicates readiness before appointments. Clients provide appointment and support details, Scheduling Agents link and route requests and communicate readiness outcomes, Accessibility Coordinators assign assistants or record unavailability, and Service Assistants record preparation. Support categories, assignment rules, and delivery channels remain unresolved, while clinical treatment and transport booking are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Coordinate non-clinical accessibility support requested for scheduled appointments and communicate support readiness.
key_capabilities: Request appointments and describe needed accessibility support.
Assign Service Assistants or record support unavailability.
unresolved_points: The available accessibility-support categories are unresolved.
The Service Assistant assignment rule is unresolved.
The readiness-outcome delivery channel is unresolved.
